primitives.name: Consensus Projection Synthesis
primitives.verbatim_quote: We combine projections from all major fantasy football sites into a consensus." /> <meta property="og:description" content="Don&#8217;t trust any particular projection system?
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P_{consensus}': 'dimensionless normalized fantasy point projection', 'P_i': 'individual site projection (i=1..N)', 'w_i': 'weight for site i (sum w_i = 1)'}
primitives.assumptions: Projections are independent random variables with finite variance; weights sum to unity.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When N approaches infinity and individual variances converge to zero.

layer2.mapping: Ensemble average operator applied to heterogeneous projection data streams.

primitives.name: Positional Attribute Normalization
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'A_{pos}': 'normalized attribute vector for position p', 'p': 'player position (QB, RB, WR, etc.)'}
primitives.assumptions: Each position has distinct statistical behavior under same input features.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When positional variance exceeds inter-player variance.

layer2.mapping: Color-coded CSS classes represent isomorphic feature spaces in player evaluation.
layer2.telemetry: Cross-validation accuracy of position-specific regression models.

primitives.name: Ensemble Weighting Scheme
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'W_i': 'weight assigned to projection source i', 'S_i': 'score of source i based on historical accuracy'}
primitives.assumptions: Historical performance correlates with future reliability.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When source credibility diverges beyond threshold.

layer2.mapping: Weighted average function derived from historical validation scores.
layer2.telemetry: Rolling window correlation between weighted predictions and outcomes.

reasoning_traces.think:
The primitives form a hierarchical inference chain where ensemble weighting provides robustness against individual model bias, positional normalization ensures context-aware evaluation, and consensus synthesis integrates these into actionable forecasts. The failure mode occurs when ensemble weights become stale due to changing meta-patterns in scoring systems or when positional boundaries blur under evolving game dynamics. Dualities emerge between deterministic aggregation and stochastic modeling, with each primitive representing either a fixed kernel operation or a learned transformation. The system's resilience depends on maintaining dynamic calibration of weights and adaptive reclassification of positions.
